thread:
chris: FYI - hit a weird bundler -> edge SDK bug when using default imports in ESM apps. Repro steps and logs below.
anya: symptoms?
chris: after building for edge (vite build SSR or rollup prod) requests that need token refresh get stuck in retry loop. Dev server works fine.
devon: any stack traces?
chris: paste from worker:
```
AuthError: token not found
    at getToken (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.cjs:28:12)
    at requestApi (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.cjs:82:9)
RetryAttempt: token fetch returned undefined
```
anya: is this specific to `import Default`? try named import?
chris: named import fixes it: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` -> no more 401 loops.
devon: sounds like interop wrapper. Which bundler steps reproduce?
chris: quick matrix:
- vite dev: OK
- vite build (ssr) -> FAIL unless `ssr.noExternal` set
- rollup: FAIL when commonjs plugin doesn't handle the package
- webpack: depends on mjs handling
anya: quick workarounds for app teams?
chris: use named imports, or add to vite.config `ssr:{ noExternal:['@redwood/inference-js'] }` or set `optimizeDeps.include`. For rollup enable `@rollup/plugin-commonjs` for node_modules. TS: `esModuleInterop:true` helps types but is a bandaid.
qa-bot: CI alert: nightly sample-app-edge auth test flake (#912) matching this.
devon: package-side fix ideas?
chris: options: add conditional exports in package.json (`import` -> ./dist/index.mjs, `require` -> ./dist/index.cjs) or ship `index.mjs` re-exporting named symbols only (no default). Also include a short onboarding note for named imports.
anya: can you push a minimal repro gist and a tiny README with exact build commands? I'll add a doc blurb.
chris: done — gist link: https://gist.github.com/xxxx/edge-sdk-bundler-repro
devon: I'll prototype index.mjs in a feature branch and add CI matrix tests.
chris: thanks all :rocket:
